narrator.personaLine: You are the Narrator of Cheddar Battles — an ancient cheese archivist.
narrator.registerLine: Your register is dry, precise, and British (Terry Pratchett calibration).
examples: Three rounds to two. The narrowest acceptable victory. Round five was yours. The Narrator observed it with considerable interest.
Four rounds produced nothing. One round produced everything. The ledger does not find this proportionate. The ledger records it anyway.
No rounds won. The Narrator notes the score and the transfer and nothing else. Both numbers are definitive.

examples.note: as a closer — brevity used deliberately after a longer setup

disciplineNounLines.ornateVocabLine: - Never use ornate vocabulary where plain vocabulary works. "Cheddar transferred" not "coffers depleted". "Now holds" not "ascending to".
disciplineNounLines._r71r12: CONFLICT-R71-R12 identity mapping (incumbent maps to itself). See app/data/treatments/mapping.json and docs/decision-graph.md.

narrator._note: The full verbatim system prompt (persona + fixed discipline lines) ships as product data at app/data/narrator-prompt.txt per R71/R73, and is reproduced byte-for-byte by engine/narratorPrompt.js:composeNarratorPrompt(incumbentTreatment) -- see app/tests/narrator-prompt-compose.test.js. personaLine/registerLine/examples/disciplineNounLines here are the theme-bound inputs to that composition, duplicated as metadata for any UI surface that wants to label the Narrator's voice without re-deriving the whole prompt.

_namePoolNote: R59: naming is the pool's job alone. This pool is drawn on for freshly-summoned player characters at random (minus any name currently in use by a live character or NPC on the shared ledger). The first seven entries are also the R82 seed roster's canonical NPC names; a summon draw skips names currently seated as NPCs in the active lobby.
_seedRosterNote: R82: the first seven entries are the exact canonical seed roster (names, elements, F/W/A tendencies verbatim). Remaining entries are the same roster 'extended in the same voice' per R82's closing clause, for lobbies needing more than 7 NPC seats across concurrent brackets/tiers. NPC brains apply this tendency distribution as their PvE-policy commit mix.

copy.truthLine: This is play money. It's free, and it lives right here in the game. Reserving your spot puts you on the notification list for the real-money launch — nothing more.
copy.landingSubhead: Five rounds. One winner. Summon a Wizard, enter the bracket, keep what you take.
copy.screenerBody: A couple of quick questions — age and location — before we let you into the arena. This is a simulated verdict for the play-money build.
copy.screenerJurisdictionQuestion: Do you currently reside in a permitted region?
copy.screenerRejectedMessage: The arena isn't open to you yet under these answers. Nothing was charged and nothing was saved beyond this screening result.
copy.summonBody: Every Wizard comes summoned with a name already on it. The pool names them; you play them.
copy.signupGrantNotice: New account bonus: $25 play CASH, already in your wallet.
copy.sittingBody: This Wizard lost its last duel. Re-enter this tier, cash out, or sit — free, indefinitely.
copy.emptiedCardLine: Holds nothing. The ledger will take the name.
copy.emptiedChampionLine: Topped the ladder, cashed out at 20:1, and holds nothing now. The ledger will take the name.
copy.tieLine: All square — coin flip. {ADVANCE_OR_ELIMINATED}. No cheddar transferred.
copy.reserveBody: Press RESERVE to join the notification list for the real-money launch. Play money is free and stays in the game either way.
copy.reserveConfirmed: You're on the list. We'll notify you when the real-money version launches.
copy.loadFundsHeading: PLAY CASH ONLY · How much would you like to deposit?
copy.loadFundsLegal: Play money is free and lives inside the game. Deposits here are simulated — no bank, no card, no real funds move.
copy.cashOutBody: Convert this Wizard's stake to CASH at 20:1. The Wizard retires. This is the only way to retire a Wizard that still holds a stake — an emptied (0C) Wizard retires to the ledger instead.
copy.withdrawBody: PLAY CASH ONLY. This shows your balance; nothing leaves the game.
copy.moneyTruthBadge: PLAY MONEY · FREE · STAYS IN GAME
copy.narratorBypassA: Both wizards committed to [ELEMENT]. All five rounds. The Narrator is familiar with this particular theory of cooperation. The Narrator is also familiar with how it typically resolves.
copy.narratorBypassB: [EEEEE] versus [EEEEE]. The Narrator notes this is either a remarkable coincidence or a remarkable miscalculation of human nature. Possibly both.
copy._narratorBypassNote: R73 static bypass, verbatim. '[ELEMENT]' is replaced with the committed element's label; '[EEEEE]' is replaced with the element label rendered in the game's data face (both occurrences get the same value) — the surrounding words are never altered.
copy._provisionalStageLabelNote: CB-BUILD-007 (docs/cb-build-patch-log.md): the incumbent ships bundled character art (assets/cw-asset-bundle/renders/gifs/) and never renders the provisional-stage badge (app/ui/components/battle/stage.js checks treatment.id !== 'incumbent' before showing it). Present here only so every treatment carries the same copy key set (see app/tests/treatments-schema.test.js); left empty because it is unused.
